params.body:
The copy update brief for gentells.com (Portal mail:47): the new wording, plus the small fixes from the same brief that need no layout change. Layout, sections, CSS and illustrations stay as they are. Pricing waits for a billing decision and is not in this PR (#260).

Closes #259
Closes #261
Closes #262
Closes #263
Closes #264
Closes #265

## Copy (#259)

- Home: hero paragraph, the platform line under the numbers (also in the strip shown without a measurement), How we read steps 01 and 03, the Where AI stops intro and its three columns (third title now "Stay relevant"), the three Built for professionals labels and lines.
- Post cards: the call reads "Read the post" on every card, locked or not.
- Reports: the line under "A new report every month." gains its first sentence.
- Contact: "Custom research and strategy sessions" with the new text. The booking link is not supplied yet, so the sentence keeps its current ending and link to trendwolves.com until it is.
- Newsletter: "Gentells This Week" everywhere on the site: the band (wordmark kept, "This Week" beside it), the contact page block and button, the home card, the confirmation mail and page, pricing, services, privacy and terms. New block text.
- Footer: "A Trendwolves product · Developed by Maarten Leyts".
- Lifestage filter on Posts: no change needed. The row lists the lifestages that posts carry (`Taxonomy::lifestagesWithContent`), so Students and Young Families appear by themselves once a post is tagged with them.

Left alone because the brief names only the hero: the same old sentence in the footer and the home meta description.

## Trends list counts (#261)

`TrendCard::evidenceLine()` reads "69 signals, 34 sources, 11 platforms", leaving out a count of nought. The verdict wording was already gone since #257. The brief writes the counts with middle dots; this uses commas, as the site's house style avoids chains of middle dots. Changing it is one line in `evidenceLine()`.

## Small fixes

- #262: the Observatory links (nav, mobile menu, account page) open in a new tab with `rel="noopener"`.
- #264: the line under the graph says "Pinch to zoom." on touch screens (`pointer-coarse`). The graph had zoom switched off apart from ctrl or cmd with the wheel, so a pinch did nothing; it is now on where the pointer is coarse. A mouse wheel still scrolls the page.
- #263: the Premium chip shows only when the post is premium and closed to that reader (`Article::showsPremiumTo`). The post page, the featured post on Posts and the reading room asked only `isPremium()`, so a subscriber saw Premium on posts they read in full; the cards asked only `isLockedFor()`, so a signed-out visitor saw Premium on the open fifteen too, which ask for a free account, not a plan. Not changed: a signed-out visitor still gets the teaser of every post (`Article::isLockedFor`), while the Reports page says the fifteen most recent are "open to everyone". One of the two should change; that is a decision, not part of this PR.
- #265: the contact form no longer requires a consent box; the privacy text already gives legitimate interest as the basis for answering. A separate unticked box "Send me Gentells This Week. I can unsubscribe at any time." subscribes through the same double opt-in as the newsletter form (source `contact`), and a failing confirmation mail does not fail the message. A short privacy line sits under the button.

## Tests

Full suite green apart from BuildStampTest, which fails in any worktree without a build stamp (LiveNumbersTest asserted the old platform line and was updated). New tests: the contact form without a consent box, the newsletter box with its confirmation, the box unticked by default, and the Premium chip rule.

params.title: Copy update for gentells.com, and five small fixes from the same brief
